description.value: The Canadian Princess Lodge is a historic 46-room waterfront lodge and marina perched on the edge of the Ucluelet Boat Basin, halfway between Long Beach and the Wild Pacific Trail. All rooms include private balconies, fridges, microwaves, and free WiFi, with most offering water or garden views. The lodge makes an excellent base for touring cyclists exploring Pacific Rim National Park Reserve, the Wild Pacific Trail, and the surrounding west coast scenery.
